text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High error rate observed on inference-hosts in us-west-2 — spike in KV cache eviction and 5xx on gen endpoints. PagerID PGR-1123.
jamie: on it, pulling logs and starting triage. will post quick timeline.
ravi: @jamie any idea on customer impact? are we seeing 5xx for hosted customers or only Dedicated?
jamie: seeing ~8% 5xx concentrated on Dedicated pod pool-3, gen+embed endpoints. latency p95 jumped 3x. early signs KV missstorm + queue growth.
customer-success: got two support tickets from Acme Inc reporting timeouts on embed endpoint around 09:12-09:25 UTC. they reported retries causing higher costs.
mei: quick hypothesis: recent quant rollout (09:07) seems correlated. quantized kernels slower on certain inference paths -> higher per-request time -> cache entries evicted -> missstorm -> batching queues grow.
jamie: I'm rolling back the canary quant flag now on inf-canary-3: `kubectl set env deploy/inf-canary-3 ENABLE_QUANT=false`
incident-bot: Deploybot: rollback triggered for deploy/inf-canary-3 — CI checks passing, rolling update started.
ravi: good. if rollback stabilizes we should prepare full rollback playbook + postmortem. propose postmortem + follow-up tomorrow 14:00 UTC. @sre-lead @product please ack.
mei: also recommend temporary batching window change to 10ms to shrink queue bubble while we investigate. opened branch `github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4823` with the change.
jamie: increased KV cache size on pool-3 and enabled throttling to shed load. verified with quick check: `redis-cli -h kv-agg info | grep evicted` — eviction rate dropped after cache bump. observed p95 latency moving back toward baseline after rollback + cache increase.
customer-success: we'll notify Acme that we've rolled back the canary and are monitoring. will keep them updated.
sre-lead: I'll own the postmortem. please create initial timeline in the doc and list logs + dashboards. proposed action items: (1) Require perf-gate for quant rollouts (owner: mei, due: 2025-01-10) (2) Add alert for KV eviction rate > 100/s (owner: ravi, due: 2025-01-07) (3) Batching tuning sweep and workload profiles (owner: infra-sig, due: 2025-01-15).
jamie: created doc with logs & preliminary timeline: https://a.internal/redwood/postmortems/PGR-1123 — added links to logs and trace spans.
ravi: I'll add alert rules and dashboards. will queue a safe canary test with rollback flag for Dedicated pool-3.
mei: Action: I'll prepare quant rollout checklist + perf gate tests and add them to the release pipeline. will PR today and ping for review.
jamie: :thumbsup: leaving runbook notes in the pager handoff. handing off monitoring to night oncall @ravi in 30m.
ravi: ack handoff. continuing to monitor metrics — p95 latency dropped from ~200ms to ~95ms after the fix. keeping pages for any reoccurrence.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: impact mitigated, monitoring window initiated for 1h. Postmortem scheduled for 2025-01-11 14:00 UTC.
customer-success: thanks team — we informed Acme and offered a scheduled postmortem.
